पावर स्टार पवन कल्याण की फिल्मों की फीस ने हमेशा बॉक्स ऑफिस पर सुर्खियां बटोरी हैं! 🎬
आंध्र प्रदेश के डिप्टी सीएम और सुपरस्टार पवन कल्याण ने अपनी पिछली पांच फिल्मों में अलग-अलग फीस ली है।
रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक, साल 2022 की फिल्म में उन्होंने 50 करोड़ रुपये चार्ज किए थे, जो कुल बजट का 55.55 प्रतिशत था।
साल 2023 की फैंटेसी कॉमेडी के लिए भी उन्होंने लगभग 50 करोड़ रुपये की remuneration ली थी।
फिल्म Hari Hara Veera Mallu के लिए ट्रेड में चर्चा थी कि उन्होंने 11 से 20 करोड़ रुपये लिए, जो भारी कटौती थी।
प्रेस मीट में एक्टर ने कहा कि वह प्रोड्यूसर्स की मदद और कोरोना व राजनीतिक कारणों से हुई देरी के कारण जिम्मेदारी महसूस करते हैं।
उनकी ब्लॉकबस्टर फिल्म They Call Him OG के लिए रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक उन्हें 100 करोड़ रुपये का रिकॉर्ड paycheck मिला था।
उनकी लेटेस्ट 2026 रिलीज Ustaad Bhagat Singh के लिए उन्होंने 25 करोड़ रुपये चार्ज किए, जिसका कारण राजनीतिक व्यस्तताएं और प्रोड्यूसर के साथ करीबी रिश्ता बताया गया है।
क्या आपकी कोई पसंदीदा पवन कल्याण फिल्म है? 🍿

ctx.title: Pawan Kalyan’s Salary For Last 5 Films: From 100 Crore For OG To 25 Crore For Ustaad Bhagat Singh
ctx.summary:
Pawan Kalyan's salary graph has been quite interesting as far as his last five films are considered. Managing an active political and film career has come with some significant changes in his paycheck.  
 The post  Pawan Kalyan’s Salary For Last 5 Films: From 100 Crore For OG To 25 Crore For Ustaad Bhagat Singh  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
Pawan Kalyan made his much-awaited comeback to films in 2021 with Vakeel Saab. His latest release was the 2026 Telugu film Ustaad Bhagat Singh. He is not just one of the most popular stars in Telugu-speaking states but also the Deputy Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh. Along with his films, his hefty paychecks have often been the talk of the town around the time of their releases.
However, his last five films have shown some interesting trends in his remuneration. Usually, actors increase their salaries with every film. But Pawan Kalyan has indicated that he focuses on the needs of a film over his own paycheck. Scroll ahead to see how much Pawan Kalyan reportedly charged for his last five films and what it says about his passion for cinema.
The 2022 film was an official Telugu remake of the 2020 Malayalam release Ayyappanum Koshiyum. It was directed by Saagar K. Chandra and featured Rana Daggubati alongside Pawan Kalyan. Upon its release, the action thriller opened to mixed reviews from critics. It was reported that the Power Star had charged a whopping 50 crore for the film, while its total budget was said to be 90 crore. If calculated, the actor took away a staggering 55.55% of the total budget as his remuneration.
For this 2023 fantasy comedy, Pawan Kalyan reportedly charged approximately 50 crore in remuneration.
Before the film’s release, there was chatter in trade circles that the actor had charged just 11–20 crore as his remuneration. This was a 60–78% salary cut compared to his previous film, Bro.
In fact, for Hari Hara Veera Mallu , Pawan Kalyan also held a press meet to promote it, an activity he is not known to engage in frequently. When asked at the press meet why he had decided to promote his film, the actor said, “These are extenuating circumstances. I usually don’t promote my films, and I feel producers have suffered because of me. First, there was Corona, a natural disaster and a man-made disaster due to politics. I now feel some sort of responsibility towards promoting films that have been delayed.”
He also spoke about his remuneration for the film at the meet. “Because even my remuneration for this… (laughs). I don’t know, I’ll consider it if it may become a hit tomorrow. My idea is that the film should be released first and do well to safeguard the producer.”
Despite his ups and downs at the box office, producers are still willing to place big bets on the actor and his stardom. For his hit film, They Call Him OG , he received a record paycheck. Reportedly, he received 100 crore for his role in the film.
For his latest film, he once again followed the approach seen with Hari Hara Veera Mallu. He charged 25 crore for the film. It was reported that he reduced his fee due to constant production delays caused by his political commitments. It is also reported that the Power Star shares a close relationship with the producer, Mythri Movie Makers, who supported him during the financial difficulties surrounding his earlier film, Hari Hara Veera Mallu.
